cells.description: FS01 ext4 control (cell ext4_control): loop-mounted ext4 image via privileged provision. Hardlink alias identity, rename-follows-name key survival and delete-marker custody. Requires loop + mkfs + mount authority; without TT04_MANIFEST the cell skips naming the missing provision.
cells.name: fs01-ext4-control

cells.description: FS02 btrfs stat-vs-maps split (cell split_and_collision_are_required): unprivileged subvolume fixtures prove stat dev never renders in maps. Requires btrfs tooling plus a btrfs-backed scratch; otherwise the cell skips with the exact btrfs refusal.
cells.name: fs02-btrfs-split

cells.description: FS03 btrfs distinct-object collision (cell split_and_collision_are_required): snapshot-pinned pairs share raw maps keys; both held objects yield at most KeyCompatible, never ExactRange. Same requirements as FS02.
cells.name: fs03-btrfs-collision

cells.description: FS04 overlay xino=off (cell overlay_xino_off_aligned): same-fs stack, lower inode passthrough with split device domain; merged KeyCompatible, unmapped upper KeyMismatch.
cells.name: fs04-overlay-xino-off

cells.description: FS05 overlay xino=on (cell overlay_xino_on_split): tmpfs lower plus btrfs upper so layers span filesystems and xino composes inodes (same-fs stacks ignore xino=on; the provisioner verifies effectiveness and degrades honestly).
cells.name: fs05-overlay-xino-on

cells.description: FS06 copy-up trigger (cell copy_up_trigger_must_happen): the upper artifact, intact lower and new merged bytes are proven before any reuse verdict; same-(dev,ino,size) copy-up refuses old-proof reuse via ChangedSource/WrongContext.
cells.name: fs06-copy-up

cells.description: FS07 metacopy profile (cell metacopy_transition): chmod yields a zero-block upper stub with split modes and intact lower data; a later data write materializes blocks. Kernel metacopy support verified at provision; refusal is recorded, never silent.
cells.name: fs07-metacopy

cells.description: FS08 foreign views + churn (cells wrong_mount_view_rejected, overmount_reads_target_view, mount_churn_keeps_retained_views, nspid_sequence_across_pidns, replaced_root_target): foreign-mount/pidns/chroot sleepers plus a barrier-synchronized churn driver. Wrong-view reads refuse by mount domain; retained FDs survive churn; foreign views never see observer churn.
cells.name: fs08-foreign-view-churn

cells.description: FS09 real denials (cell restricted_denial_is_real): mode-000 reopen refusal, pid-1 acquisition Denied and map_files Denied on an owned child. Non-root callers only; run as root the cell skips (root bypasses DAC).
cells.name: fs09-restricted-denial

cells.description: FS10 transient mmap audit (cell transient_target_mmap_detected): the shipped ptrace tracer flags a planted transient target mmap closed by munmap, and shows zero target-backed maps (with live allocator mmaps) across the real NoNew production phase. Requires ptrace of an owned child; refusal skips with the yama/errno cause.
cells.name: fs10-transient-mmap-audit
